classification.source_level_rationale: created in the course of the activity it documents: This is a contemporary administrative record of a parliamentary debate on media literacy in education.
classification.resume: This is a digital parliamentary record of the Swiss National Council's 2013 autumn session, documenting a petition from the Youth Session calling for media literacy to be included in the education mandate. Maya Graf is listed as the speaker in the debate. The record is an official transcript and video recording of the parliamentary discussion.
